title: Architecture overview: edge and web tier
author: Grace Nakamura
brief: Design doc describing the customer-facing tier: web-dashboard talks only to api-gateway, which authenticates via auth-service and reads settings from config-service. Names the owners of api-gateway and web-dashboard in a ownership table. Does NOT describe anything below auth-service.

title: Identity and session design
author: Noor Haddad
brief: Design doc for auth-service: login, token introspection, and how session state lives in session-cache. Credits Lukas Brandt for the 2025 Redis sharding layer and lists him as session-cache owner; states the session TTL is 3600 seconds (true at the time, becomes stale). Notes auth-service reads its settings from config-service. Noor Haddad is auth-service owner.

title: Payments architecture
author: Daniel Kwon
brief: Architecture page for the payment path: payment-gateway calls auth-service for token introspection on every request, then fraud-scoring, ledger-service and bank-connector (still named bankbridge in this June doc, use the old name). Lists owners Daniel Kwon and Elif Yildiz. Does not mention the event bus.

title: Data platform overview
author: Samir Haddad
brief: Overview of the data side: event-pipeline (owner Samir Haddad) is the broker; ledger-service publishes to it, fraud-scoring and reporting-service consume from it; reporting-service also reads ledger-service directly. Lists owners Kofi Mensah (fraud-scoring) and Olivia Hartmann (reporting-service).

title: config-service guide
author: Chen Wei
brief: How to use config-service and the cfgctl CLI; Chen Wei owns it and built the push pipeline. States that any Platform engineer can push production config on their own (true until 2026-08-14, becomes stale). bank-connector's per-bank settings (still called bankbridge in this doc) live here.

title: notification-service README
author: Tessa Ngu
brief: Service README: Tessa Ngu owns notification-service; it consumes events from event-pipeline to send invoice reminder emails and webhooks, and reads templates and throttles from config-service. Includes a retry section (distractor for later duplicate-email incident, no incident mentioned).

title: Runbook: session-cache operations
author: Beatrice Oyelaran
brief: On-call runbook for session-cache written by Beatrice Oyelaran after INC-01: how to drain and flush a shard, never FLUSHALL, which Grafana alerts she built and the sessctl tool. States current TTL 900 s (stale after 2026-08-12) and that memory was raised to 8 GB.

title: Runbook: roll back a config change
author: Mateo Alvarez
brief: Written the day after INC-03: the cfgctl rollback command and its ~30 second propagation, tell on-call. Says that today any Platform engineer can still push to prod alone, with a rollback as the safety net (true on 2026-08-11, stale after 2026-08-14); does not narrate the incident.

title: Runbook: resubmitting an ACH batch
author: Sam Okafor
brief: Runbook for bank-connector owner Sam Okafor: bankctl resubmit with --same-day, only before the customer's cutoff (Tidewater 17:30 ET; default 14:00 ET) and after the customer contact acknowledges. Written after INC-02; mentions the incident only as 'last week's late batches'.

title: Runbook: dedupe and backfill reporting totals
author: Olivia Hartmann
brief: Olivia Hartmann's runbook for reportctl dedupe (--dry-run first, key txn_id) which she wrote. No incident narrative; references 'the replay earlier this week' only.

title: Deploy checklist and Friday policy
author: Mateo Alvarez
brief: Deploy checklist: 10% canary for 15 minutes, abort if error rate above 1%, plus a note that no production deploys happen on Fridays starting 2026-07-03. Never updated after the freeze is lifted (stale-on-purpose; writers must not fix it).

title: On-call and incident process
author: Mateo Alvarez
brief: Process doc: Monday 10:00 UTC handover, incident commanders rotate among Mateo Alvarez, Beatrice Oyelaran and Viktor Sokolov, SEV1 means payments down and pages immediately. Generic, no incidents.

title: Onboarding a customer bank to bank-connector
author: Sam Okafor
brief: How-to for adding a bank: per-bank overrides under bank_connector.banks.<id>.* in config-service plus a contract test; default cutoff 14:00 ET. Says the component was 'formerly bankbridge' in one aside.

title: Engineering handbook: teams and ownership
author: Grace Nakamura
brief: Handbook page after the reorg: six teams, Tobias Wren is CTO and signs off ADRs, Maggie Ellison is CEO; ownership table where session-cache now lists Mateo Alvarez (Platform). Does not explain why.

title: Customer account overview
author: Anjali Deshpande
brief: Account sheet for six customers (Orchard & Vane, Northgate Freight, Kilnworth Dental Group with 9 clinics, Saltmarsh Foods, Tidewater Credit Union with the 17:30 ET ACH cutoff override, Bluepeak Logistics which uses CSV exports). Names the Pellucid contact for each. Bluepeak vs Northgate look-alike is deliberate.

title: Config change policy
author: Chen Wei
brief: Policy page after ADR-011: one approver plus cfglint validation, with the validator bounds for auth.introspection_timeout_ms (200 to 5000 ms) among other keys. Chen Wei wrote and maintains cfgctl and the pipeline. Does not mention the earlier two-approver rule.

title: ADR-001: Remember this device (30-day device trust)
author: Ravi Chandrasekar
brief: Standard ADR: adopt a 30-day device-trust window so users skip repeated MFA; context is enterprise complaints (Kilnworth among them). Decided by Anjali Deshpande and Ravi Chandrasekar, approved by Tobias Wren. Consequences section mentions 'extra state per login' but not capacity.

title: ADR-002: Transactional outbox for ledger events
author: Elif Yildiz
brief: ADR (ledger-service publishes to event-pipeline) proposed by Elif Yildiz, who wrote the outbox publisher in ledger-service; decided by Sofia Marchetti, approved by Tobias Wren. Rationale: avoid dual-write inconsistency between ledger database and the event bus. Mentions key = transaction id loosely (no precise format).

title: ADR-003: Session-cache policy (TTL, eviction, memory)
author: Noor Haddad
brief: After INC-01: TTL 900 s, eviction policy volatile-ttl, 8 GB; decided by Noor Haddad, approved by Ravi Chandrasekar. Context cites INC-01 by id only.

title: ADR-004: No production deploys on Fridays
author: Mateo Alvarez
brief: Friday freeze effective 2026-07-03; decided by Mateo Alvarez, approved by Tobias Wren; context is INC-05 (Friday 16:40 deploy, weekend fix). Consequence: hotfixes need CTO exception.

title: ADR-005: Rename bankbridge to bank-connector
author: Sam Okafor
brief: Rename effective 2026-07-20; proposed by Sam Okafor, decided by Sofia Marchetti, approved by Tobias Wren; reasons: collides with the bankbridge-sim test mock and the <noun>-connector convention. The migration checklist lists code, dashboards and docs only (the gap matters later; do not point it out).

title: ADR-006: Platform owns shared stateful infrastructure
author: Tobias Wren
brief: Accepted 2026-08-11: session-cache moves from Identity to Platform effective 2026-09-01. Decided by Tobias Wren, approved by Maggie Ellison. Rationale is vague ('recent operational load on Identity'); it does NOT name INC-01 (that link is in meeting notes).

title: ADR-007: Lower session idle TTL to 300 seconds
author: Noor Haddad
brief: Session idle TTL 900 s to 300 s, driven by SOC 2 finding AF-12 from the audit firm Ashgrove Assurance; proposed by Noor Haddad (who wrote the token introspection endpoint), decided by Tobias Wren, approved by Ravi Chandrasekar. Mentions audit-log retention of 900 days as a distractor.

title: ADR-008: Two approvals for production config changes
author: Mateo Alvarez
brief: Effective immediately: two approvals for production config. Proposed by Mateo Alvarez, decided by Tobias Wren, approved by Grace Nakamura; context cites INC-03 by id and 'an unreviewed typo' without naming customers or the setting.

title: ADR-009: Idempotency key contract for events
author: Samir Haddad
brief: Idempotency key is txn_id only, immutable, with a consumer contract test. Proposed by Samir Haddad, decided by Sofia Marchetti and Yusuf Demir, approved by Tobias Wren; context cites INC-04 by id only.

title: ADR-010: Lift the Friday deploy freeze
author: Mateo Alvarez
brief: Friday deploys allowed before 14:00 UTC with a canary; decided by Mateo Alvarez and Grace Nakamura, approved by Tobias Wren; reason: freeze delayed fixes, canary tooling matured. Supersedes ADR-004 explicitly.

title: ADR-011: One approver plus automated validation for config
author: Chen Wei
brief: Replaces the two-approver rule of ADR-008: one approver plus cfglint. Proposed by Chen Wei, decided by Tobias Wren, approved by Grace Nakamura; reason: median wait of 3.5 hours and cfglint would have caught the INC-03 typo. Admits this is a partial reversal.

title: IDN-212: Implement remember-device trust records
author: Lukas Brandt
brief: Implementation ticket assigned to Lukas Brandt. Description says a device-trust record is written next to each session; comments mention session TTL of 3600 s. Status closed on 2026-06-15 after v2.14 ships. No capacity discussion.

title: SUP-318: Kilnworth users keep getting logged out
author: Jonas Albrecht
brief: Support ticket by Jonas Albrecht: Kilnworth Dental Group (9 clinics) first to report repeated forced re-logins. Frustrated customer tone; comments show the escalation to on-call and a closing note.

title: INC-01: Mass logouts on web-dashboard
author: Mateo Alvarez
brief: Incident ticket with timeline; Mateo Alvarez is incident commander. Finds session-cache evictions; no root cause for the memory pressure yet.

title: INC-01 RCA: session-cache memory pressure
author: Noor Haddad
brief: Post-incident root cause note by Noor Haddad (auth-service keeps sessions in session-cache): remember-device (v2.14) added a second record per login and doubled entries; memory raised from 4 GB to 8 GB on 2026-06-17. Blameless tone; mentions the feature but not who built it.

title: CFG-4380: Lower session.ttl_seconds from 3600 to 900
author: Beatrice Oyelaran
brief: Config change record: session.ttl_seconds 3600 to 900, applied 2026-06-18 with one reviewer. Closed. Notes the setting's previous value explicitly.

title: IDN-230: Capacity model must count per-login records
author: Ravi Chandrasekar
brief: Follow-up ticket: any feature adding per-login records must update the session-cache capacity model before shipping. New joiner Imani Okoye picks it up (her first ticket). Casual tone, links INC-01 by key only.

title: INC-05: Duplicate invoice reminder emails
author: Tessa Ngu
brief: Minor incident from Friday 2026-06-26 16:40 UTC: notification-service retry bug sent duplicate emails to about 400 recipients; Tessa Ngu fixed over the weekend. Deliberate lexical overlap with later 'duplicate' events incident; unrelated cause (template retry).

title: PLAT-640: Raise api-gateway per-tenant rate limit for Orchard & Vane
author: Viktor Sokolov
brief: Request by Viktor Sokolov: raise per-tenant limit from 100 to 250 requests/s for Orchard & Vane's seasonal import; applied 2026-07-09. Mentions the old value 100 in the description.

title: PLAT-702: Gateway load test results
author: Beatrice Oyelaran
brief: Load-test report (gateway calls auth-service on every request): at the current 250 requests/s per-tenant ceiling auth-service saturates; no decision in this ticket (decision lands in the next ticket). Uses the number 250 as 'current'.

title: CFG-4463: Lower per-tenant rate limit to 180
author: Viktor Sokolov
brief: Config change: per-tenant limit 250 to 180 req/s applied 2026-09-14, done by Viktor Sokolov with Noor Haddad reviewing; references the load test ticket by key.

title: PAY-455: Rename bankbridge to bank-connector
author: Sam Okafor
brief: Task checklist by Sam Okafor: code, dashboards, docs, alerts (config key namespaces absent from the checklist; do not point this out). Written under the old name bankbridge. Sam executes the rename on 2026-07-20 per comments.

title: SUP-341: Tidewater ACH settled next business day
author: Jonas Albrecht
brief: Support ticket from Tidewater Credit Union: same-day ACH batches settled a day late. Customer tone: polite but firm about SLA; mentions their 17:30 ET agreement. Written by Jonas Albrecht.

title: INC-02: Tidewater same-day ACH missed cutoff
author: Sam Okafor
brief: Incident ticket by Sam Okafor: bank-connector used the 14:00 ET default; the Tidewater override sat under the old bankbridge key prefix in config-service. Does not say why the old prefix remained.

title: CFG-4402: Alias old bankbridge keys, migrate overrides
author: Chen Wei
brief: Chen Wei adds an alias mapping from old bankbridge.* to bank_connector.* keys; Sam Okafor migrates keys and manually resubmits Tidewater batches. Closed same day.

title: PAY-462: Rename checklist follow-up
author: Sam Okafor
brief: Follow-up from INC-02: rename checklist must also cover config namespaces, alerts and dashboards. Sam Okafor updates the checklist template.

title: SUP-357: Checkout failing for Orchard & Vane
author: Jonas Albrecht
brief: Urgent support ticket: Orchard & Vane (and later Saltmarsh Foods) seeing HTTP 502 at checkout from 09:12 UTC; Maggie Ellison escalates as exec sponsor. Customer-centric, no cause known.

title: INC-03: Payment authorizations returning 502
author: Mateo Alvarez
brief: Incident ticket by Mateo Alvarez: payment-gateway introspection calls to auth-service time out; rollback of CFG-4411 at 09:50 UTC resolves. 41 minutes in total. Names CFG-4411 as the suspect change but not its content.

title: CFG-4411: Tune auth introspection timeout
author: Chen Wei
brief: Config change record by Chen Wei: auth.introspection_timeout_ms 800 to 80, no reviewer, pushed immediately (the typo is visible only as the numbers). Also mentions web-dashboard client timeout of 80 seconds in a comment (distractor).

title: PLAT-690: INC-03 action items
author: Mateo Alvarez
brief: Post-incident action items: second approver rule (becomes ADR-008) and input validation; lesson that prod config changes need validation and a second pair of eyes. Tone is blameless.

title: SEC-9: SOC 2 finding AF-12 (idle sessions)
author: Ravi Chandrasekar
brief: Security ticket relaying auditor Ashgrove Assurance's finding AF-12: idle sessions over 5 minutes on payment-capable accounts. Compliance tone; no decision yet. Mentions audit-log retention 900 days as a distractor.

title: DATA-318: Tighten event-pipeline consumer poll interval
author: Samir Haddad
brief: Samir Haddad changes consumer.max_poll_interval_ms from 300000 to 60000 to detect stuck consumers faster; shipped 2026-09-07. No risk notes.

author: Elif Yildiz

title: SUP-388: Northgate totals look doubled
author: Jonas Albrecht
brief: Support ticket: Northgate Freight (month-end close approaching) reports about 2x invoice totals on about 3,000 invoices. Anjali Deshpande speaks with their finance lead. Bluepeak CSV export ticket is mentioned as 'unrelated'.

author: Yusuf Demir
brief: Incident ticket by Yusuf Demir: events republished by the ledger-service outbox after a broker rebalance on 2026-09-08 were counted twice by reporting-service. Does not state the trigger or the key change.

title: DATA-325: Dedupe backfill executed
author: Olivia Hartmann
brief: Olivia Hartmann records the dedupe backfill she ran on 2026-09-10 and the revert of the key format on 2026-09-09. Numbers of affected rows included.

title: PAY-510: Consumer contract test for idempotency keys
author: Elif Yildiz
brief: Elif Yildiz adds a consumer contract test that fails if the key shape changes; lesson stated in a comment. Closed.

title: SUP-401: Bluepeak CSV export timing out
author: Jonas Albrecht
brief: Unrelated report: Bluepeak Logistics CSV exports time out on large date ranges; reporting-service query fix. Distractor for Northgate and reporting totals.

title: PLAT-715: Update CODEOWNERS after reorg
author: Grace Nakamura
brief: Grace Nakamura updates CODEOWNERS: services/session-cache/ now lists Mateo Alvarez (previously Lukas Brandt), effective 2026-09-02. Notes Lukas stays on as an informal reviewer for the sharding layer.

title: PLAT-742: Roll out cfglint
author: Chen Wei
brief: Chen Wei rolls out cfglint in the push pipeline: bounds for auth.introspection_timeout_ms are 200 to 5000 ms. References the new one-approver rule.

title: EXP-77: Status page DNS TTL
author: Arjun Malhotra
brief: Distractor: status page DNS TTL set to 300 seconds, with a comment about the old 3600. No relation to session TTL. Light tone.

title: #identity: scoping remember device
author: Anjali Deshpande
brief: Anjali relays that enterprise customers (Kilnworth for one) are annoyed by daily MFA prompts; Ravi and Lukas discuss scope. Casual chat, ends with 'let's write the ADR'.

author: Mateo Alvarez

brief: Beatrice announces TTL 3600 to 900 is live; Noor confirms login metrics are healthy. Short.

brief: Viktor announces per-tenant limit 100 to 250 req/s for Orchard & Vane's seasonal import; Anjali thanks him. Includes old value in passing.

title: #payments: rename naming bikeshed
author: Sam Okafor
brief: Sam Okafor pitches bank-connector; Daniel dislikes the old name colliding with bankbridge-sim; Sofia decides; Elif jokes. Casual.

author: Tobias Wren

brief: All-hands agenda item: freeze started 2026-07-03, reasons, proposal to lift with canary; vote tomorrow. Mixed opinions.
